name: Pulse Heart
description: A like pill that beats on every press: the heart contracts, springs out of place, and the counter digit rolls up one step like an odometer.
interactionNotes: Click the pill or press it with `Enter`/`Space` to toggle between liked and not liked and move the count up or down by one. With mouse and touch the full beat plays — the heart contracts to `dotSize` and overshoots its mark by `overshoot`, the pill shrinks by `beat` percent and the changed digit rolls over `rollDuration`. With the keyboard the beat is skipped: state and count change instantly so the user does not wait for the animation. If `prefers-reduced-motion` is on, the pointer path becomes that same instant swap.

props.name: liked
props.description: Controlled state; pass it to own the state. An external change settles without playing the beat.

props.name: defaultLiked
props.description: Initial state in uncontrolled mode.

props.name: count
props.description: The number shown; each press adds or subtracts one. Rendering uses Persian digits and a thousands separator.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Gives the new state and count on every press.

props.name: showCount
props.description: Whether the count is shown; turning it off collapses the pill into a circle.

props.name: icon
props.description: Built-in glyph or any custom element.

props.name: idleOutline
props.description: Whether the idle icon is outlined; turning it off gives a dimmed solid version.

props.name: size
props.description: Icon size, px; padding, gap and counter size derive from it.

props.name: corner
props.description: Pill corner radius, px.

props.name: likedColor
props.description: Color after liking, the hover tint and the focus ring.

props.name: idleColor
props.description: Color before liking.

props.name: pillColor
props.description: Background of the pill that beats beneath the icon.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Counter color.

props.name: duration
props.description: Total beat duration, ms; the return always happens within 40% of it.

props.name: dotSize
props.description: Ratio the icon shrinks to at the return moment.

props.name: overshoot
props.description: How far it overshoots the target on the return; zero means no spring.

props.name: beat
props.description: Percentage the pill shrinks by at the return moment.

props.name: rollDuration
props.description: Duration of the changed digit's roll, ms.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dimmed and unresponsive to input.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; the counter is appended to it.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class for the root.

tips: To connect to a server, take `onChange` and pass `liked` and `count` **after** the successful response — controlled mode settles an external change without playing the beat, so it does not beat twice.
The demo starts with `count={1204}` but the component itself defaults to `0`; pass the real count (e.g. the server's total likes) from the parent and do not rely on the demo value.
The odometer roll turns only that one cell when a single digit changes; if the string length changes (999 → 1,000) the whole number shifts at once — the default behavior.

The built-in icon sits inside a scalable SVG group and its stroke width comes from `--ph-stroke` (`1.5 × size / 24`). If you pass `icon` as a `ReactNode`, that element replaces the whole `<svg>` and the beat applies to the outer `<span>` — so match its stroke width to `size` yourself.
With `prefers-reduced-motion`, both the beat and the roll turn off and the color changes with a soft transition; the count still updates immediately, so nothing is lost.

This component **does not get RTL**, and that is deliberate: the layout is LTR-safe (`inline-flex` and `padding-inline-end` mirror themselves) and the beat axis is a symmetric scale around the center. Only the text and digits were made Persian — the same rule as `jelly-radio`.
